company.description: Aleph enables brands to be involved in e-commerce, giving visibility into their online sales across multiple marketplaces such as Mercado Libre, Amazon and Shopee. insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,322,822 to $29,147,926, a 5.48x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 32 (+2 over 90 days) and market heat at 71 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
